caption: Swapped the car instalment for a motorbike to survive the Brits-to-Rosslyn commute. I didn't cost the gear properly and it still adds up faster than I expected. Would you make the same trade?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R24 900
p/m salary
Living in Brits
slides.body:
Male, 26
Single, no kids
Job: Production line operator, vehicle assembly plant in Rosslyn
Net salary: R24 900 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Room in Brits, close to the road out to Rosslyn
slides.body: Cheaper than living near the plant. The commute is the trade-off.

slides.title: Motorbike instalment
slides.includes: Financed a 250cc, chose it over a car for the commute
slides.body: Half of what a car instalment quote came to. That part of the maths held up.

slides.title: Fuel, maintenance & gear
slides.includes: Fuel, tyres and chain, a helmet replaced after a crack, theft cover
slides.body: I didn't cost the gear properly when I switched. It adds up faster than the bike payment itself.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Big shop plus the days I forget lunch
slides.body: Nothing unusual here, which is more than I can say for the rest of this list.

slides.title: Medical aid
slides.includes: Bought my own plan, since it isn't compulsory at my grade
slides.body: Necessary on two wheels in Gauteng traffic. I don't want to test it, but I sleep better having it.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Phone & data, funeral policy, stokvel, savings, electricity, insurance on the bike
slides.body: R11 450 of things I've never once looked at as a group. More than a third of what I earn.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R24 900. Still better off than the car quote would have left me — just not by as much as I told people it was.

slides.title: I stopped assuming the bike was automatically cheaper
slides.body:
I uploaded three months of statements to Beyond Horizon and weighed the bike's real running cost against what the car quote would have been.

Still cheaper overall, just not by the margin I'd been telling people.

No bank login needed.
